description: Verify whether a Gulf recruitment agency is government-licensed. Look up by agency name, or by licence / facility number (e.g. a UAE MOHRE facility number or Saudi Musaned reference). Returns the licence status recorded on GCC Domestic plus the official government registry link for independent verification.

country.description: Optional country filter: uae | ksa | kuwait | qatar | bahrain | oman

name: verify_agency_licence
title: Verify an agency licence
